## Trellis: Session Track Generator (Lyria)

One track of a Trellis Session. Called once per planned track by `sessionService.generateSessionTracks` (fire-and-forget, in parallel).

**Webhook:** `https://n8n.sproutify.app/webhook/trellis-session-track-generate`

**POST body:**
```json
{
  "track_id": "uuid",
  "session_id": "uuid",
  "branch": "atl-urban-farms",
  "track_number": 1,
  "title": "...",
  "prompt": "...",
  "genre": "Jazz",
  "mood": "Mysterious",
  "vocal_style": "Instrumental only",
  "duration_seconds": 180
}
```

### SETUP (same as E1)
1. Replace `YOUR_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (3 nodes) — Hub `horvjqqifgrzxesuxtfm`.
2. Replace `YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY` (or fetch from `tenant_secrets.gemini_api_key`).
3. **⚠️ Lyria node is a SCAFFOLD** — verify model id / endpoint / body / response vs https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/music-generation. Decode the returned base64 audio to a binary field `data` before Upload.
4. Upload writes to `music-sessions/{session_id}/tracks/track-{n}.mp3` (public bucket → the audio_url is directly playable).
5. **Error path (add):** on failure PATCH the track to `status='failed'` + `error_message` (UI renders failed tracks with a Retry button).

When all approved tracks are `completed`, the user hits **Stitch Approved** → `trellis-music-stitch` (Python worker on the VPS, see /workers).

**Prereqs done:** `trellis_music_sessions/tracks/renders` tables + `music-sessions` public bucket exist (2026-07-02).
